description: This file serves as a shared prelude for channel-oriented plugin SDK surfaces, exporting various types, helper functions, schemas, and constants used across different plugin channels within the SDK.

methods.name: emptyPluginConfigSchema
methods.description: Exports a schema object representing an empty plugin configuration schema.

methods.name: normalizeAccountId
methods.description: Function to normalize account identifiers, ensuring consistent format.

methods.name: applyAccountNameToChannelSection
methods.description: Helper to apply account name within a channel section configuration.

methods.name: migrateBaseNameToDefaultAccount
methods.description: Migration helper to replace base names with default account identifiers.

methods.name: buildChannelConfigSchema
methods.description: Function to build and validate channel configuration schemas.

methods.name: deleteAccountFromConfigSection
methods.description: Removes account details from a plugin configuration section.

methods.name: setAccountEnabledInConfigSection
methods.description: Enables or disables account settings within the configuration section.

methods.name: formatPairingApproveHint
methods.description: Formats a hint message to approve pairing requests.

methods.name: PAIRING_APPROVED_MESSAGE
methods.description: Constant string used as a message indicating pairing approval.
